author: Alex Kahn
description: Read an SVG as named, recolourable parts — a part is a set of shapes, not a hex value.
name: @absolutejs/svg-parts

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build ./src/index.ts ./src/react.tsx --root ./src --outdir dist --target bun --external react --external react/* && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --project tsconfig.json
scripts.check:package: bun run format && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.release: bun run check:package && npm publish --access public --tag beta
